statement: At the pinned SDL 3.2.0 revision, structured joystick GUID byte 14 is the driver signature. HIDAPI uses h; the Linux driver uses zero signature/data and returns its native device path. Combining a matching VID/PID GUID with the exact hidraw or event path permits a conservative backend inference. Vendor-less name GUIDs, other builds and ambiguous paths remain unknown; requested hints are not evidence of driver selection.
